note: Adapted from the species description of Scheffrahn (2016), originally in English; the alate is unknown; for the soldier and worker the original records only the differences from P. mesoamericanus, so their shared characters are not added; measurements are those given in the text; type locality and figure numbers are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier and worker resemble P. mesoamericanus and differ only in the following characters. Soldier: head including nasus 1.28–1.46 mm long, maximum head width 0.66–0.78 mm, pronotum width 0.34–0.44 mm, hind tibia 0.58–0.76 mm long.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Nasus conical in dorsal view, basal width about 1.6 times the width at midlength; nasus broadly conical in profile. Mandibles short and very narrow apically. Antennae 11–12-segmented (1>2<3=4). Hind tibia usually shorter than maximum head width. Margin of the anterior lobe of the pronotum with a few longer setae (0.10 mm).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Mandibular grinding plate with about seven ridges and without a dorsal concavity; apical tooth and first marginal tooth similar in shape and prominence; third marginal tooth smaller, separated from the first marginal tooth by a slightly concave cutting edge. Enteric valve with three irregular rows of about 7–12 long, narrow, subtriangular, slightly decurved spines.
